Name: DGA Space Laser
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] to add a space laser you can place on your farm.

You can buy space lasers from the carpenter shop, or craft them yourself at Mining skill level 6.

For use with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10641]Meteor Defence[/url] mod.
